SELECT
    p.ColorName,
    sum(f.SalesAmount) / nullif(sum(f.SalesQuantity), 0) AS avg_online_unit_price_realized,
    sum(f.SalesQuantity) AS units_sold
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
    ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
WHERE p.ColorName IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.ColorName
HAVING sum(f.SalesQuantity) >= 1000
ORDER BY avg_online_unit_price_realized DESC
LIMIT 1
